exposure: Percutaneous balloon mitral valvotomy before pregnancy
Percutaneous balloon mitral valvotomy during pregnancy
outcome: Maternal cardiac events during pregnancy (NYHA class deterioration, arrhythmias, atrial fibrillation)
Obstetric events (mode of delivery, Cesarean section rate)
Neonatal outcomes (birth weight, fetal growth restriction, stillbirth, congenital malformations)
cohort: 24 women with severe rheumatic mitral stenosis who underwent percutaneous balloon mitral valvotomy (14 before pregnancy, 10 during pregnancy)
finding: Percutaneous mitral valvotomy performed during pregnancy for severe mitral stenosis is safe and results in similar maternal and fetal outcomes compared to the procedure performed before pregnancy.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was reported for both groups
